name.ja: プラノサウルス ギガノトサウルス

ja: 自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』第8弾に、最大級の肉食恐竜「ギガノトサウルス」が登場！
• 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
• 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様で恐竜の姿を復元。
• ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
• ギガノトサウルスの特徴を学説に基づき新規造形で立体化。
• 短い角のようにも見える角質に包まれた眼の上の硬質な突起を学説に基づきリアルに表現。
• 体格が似ているティラノサウルスよりも高く発達した背面の神経棘の形状を立体化。
• 獲物の肉を骨からすっぱりと切り取るような食べ方をしたと考えられる薄く鋭利な歯の特徴もリアルに再現。
• 近縁の仲間の化石から、前肢には強力な筋肉と3本の鋭い爪があったと推定される。強力な武器だったと思われる前肢を学説を基に立体化。
• 口の開閉や前肢、後肢、首や尾など各所が可動し、好みのポージングでディスプレイが可能。
en: The largest carnivorous dinosaur "Giganotosaurus " is now available in the 8th edition of " Planosaurus ", a brand that lets you " know everything about dinosaurs" with your own hands!
• "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.
• "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the dinosaur's appearance using specifications unique to plastic models, where the skin parts are attached to the top of the skeleton.
• Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.
• The characteristics of Giganotosaurus have been made into a three-dimensional model using new modeling based on theory.
• The hard protrusions above the eyes, which are covered in keratin and look like short horns, are realistically expressed based on theory.
• The shape of the neural spines on the back, which were developed higher than those of Tyrannosaurus rex, which has a similar physique, has been made into a three-dimensional model.
• The characteristics of the thin, sharp teeth that are thought to have been used to cut the meat of prey cleanly from the bone are also realistically reproduced.

• Fossils of close relatives suggest that the forelimbs had powerful muscles and three sharp claws. The forelimbs, which are thought to have been powerful weapons, have been made into three-dimensional models based on theory.
• Various parts such as the opening and closing of the mouth, front legs, hind legs, neck and tail can be moved, allowing you to display your favorite poses.
